<div class="card-body">
'''Blizzard Scout 1''' is a [[Dark]] [[Vehicle]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ブリザード・スカウト1</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットか乗客を合計で1名搭乗させられる。“リアクション”として移動できる。ホスの位置では戦闘力＋1。能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Blizzard-Scout-1-Category1Games-1076s.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">密閉型の全地形対応偵察用トランスポート（ＡＴ－ＳＴ）。ブリザード・フォースのＡＴ－ＡＴ部隊の側面を護衛する。低温下での戦闘に対応できるよう、改造が加えられている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Blizzard Scout 1.

'''Card text:'''
May carry one pilot or passenger in total. May move as a react. Power +1 at a Hoth location. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard.

'''Lore:'''
Enclosed all-terrain scout transport (AT-ST). Guards the flank of Blizzard Force’s AT-AT unit. Modified for combat at low temperatures.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 位置 (location).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Blizzard Scout 1]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
